Package com.carlcard.simulator.model

Class CreditCardAccount

java.lang.Object
com.carlcard.simulator.model.CreditCardAccount
public final class CreditCardAccount extends Object
Domain model for a single credit card account. A CreditCardAccount tracks transactions, statements, balances, interest, fees, and rewards over time. It exposes operations used by the simulator to apply interest, payments, and rewards under different strategies.
